scope: Root-only private V8 packet parsing after exact reader completion
steps: Verify complete reader status, plain envelope byte/hash, collection_complete, held_fds_closed, errors empty, all three input pins and packet inode tuple.
Decode only private_file.data into private V8 bytes; require exact28314 and full original SHA. Keep bytes and decoded message text out of Git/chat/general reports.
Require 96-byte MAGIC + exact64-hex generation + newline. Iterate257 little-endian uint32 length-prefixed complete records; no trailing bytes.
Use the exact copied source packet_header v4 conditions:28-byte '<HHiIIIII' header, size equality, buffer4, valid pid/tid/time, priority1..8, NUL tag/message terminators.
Privately group crash records by pid/tid/time and explicit Android crash headers, identify executable/signal/abort-message/backtrace if present. Tag DEBUG/libc alone is not an executable identity.

Correlate only supported process/namespace/generation metadata. Report a concise relevant cause and supporting packet offsets/hashes, without dumping messages or inferring a sender/root cause from SIGHUP alone.
Retain original Owner19 failure; propose the smallest production fix supported by the actual crash cause. No new runtime, input, or lifecycle action follows automatically.
